regime_context: China A-shares theme momentum shows a narrow, two-horse leadership structure — Banks (rank 1, score 0.998) and Innovative Pharma & CXO (rank 2, 0.988) — with only 4 of 22 themes eligible and rotation 'directional' flag false. emerging_watch: Watching whether Pharma & CXO confirms a handoff from Banks: the rotation margin is 0.01 and directional false. I would retire this watch if Banks' durability_bar stays above 0.65 and the margin widens to 0.05+ for 5 consecutive sessions (leader decisively re-asserts), OR if Pharma & CXO overtakes Banks in score while its own breadth rises above 0.75 (a confirmed, broad-based handoff).

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks sit at rank 1 with the highest durability_bar (0.73) and strong breadth (0.889), meaning leadership is broad-based within the theme rather than a single-name spike. Crowding_z of 1.78 is a SIZE-DOWN caution only, not a fade — I lean with the confirmed leader, not against it. The narrow rotation (frac 0.18, directional false) suggests no challenger has confirmed a handoff yet, so the prevailing narrative is intact.
evidence: rotation.leader = Banks; rotation.directional false (no confirmed handoff)
theses.dissent: Banks are crowded (z 1.78) and China bank rallies are frequently policy-liquidity driven and mean-reverting; the same tape that makes gate_helps false on this market (whipsaw) is the tape Banks trades on, and a crowded leader is exactly where reflexivity tops form.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS falls below CSI 300 by a cumulative 5% at any point within the next 20 trading days

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma & CXO is the only credible challenger to Banks: rank 2, score 0.988 (margin to leader only 0.01), eligible true, and durability_bar 0.60. Breadth (0.643) is lower than Banks, so this theme is less cohesive, but it is the second leg of a two-horse structure in a narrow rotation. I lean with it as the challenger while it remains eligible, but no handoff is confirmed.
theses.dissent: Pharma/CXO is also crowded (z 1.59) and its leadership may be a policy-news spike (innovative-drug/CXO licensing headlines) rather than durable flow; with rotation 'directional false' the challenger has not actually overtaken the leader, and lower breadth means the move is less broad-based.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ lags CSI 300 by 5% cumulatively before 20 trading days elapse

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: Rank 3 but score drops to 0.682 and eligible is FALSE — the trend gate has de-risked this theme out. Breadth is a whisper (0.059), meaning if anything is moving it is one or two names, not the theme. Durability_bar 0.28 is weak. The 'avoid' lean reflects the gate's display-only caution (not a short), especially given gate_helps is false on this market, so this is a low-conviction stay-away rather than a directional fade.
theses.dissent: AI Compute has a 'trend' hurst_tag (persistent trend character) and is NOT crowded (z -0.66), so if a genuine AI-capex/hardware narrative reignites in China it could re-enter quickly; avoiding it risks missing the one theme with real trend health.
